briefing: Markets fell today: the NASDAQ dropped 1.0% and the S&P 500 slipped 0.4%, so the screener flagged the day as risk-off and returned no buy candidates. With no eligible tickers, I left the $645.88 in cash idle and kept all 7 existing positions. Their automatic stop-loss and profit-target orders stay in place. The portfolio is up 49.9% overall, so protecting gains on a weak day matters more than putting the spare cash to work.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-off day is when investors get nervous and sell riskier assets like growth and tech stocks, often moving money into safer places. Riskier stocks tend to fall more on these days, which is why the NASDAQ dropped more than the S&P 500 today. Holding off on new purchases on risk-off days helps avoid buying just before prices fall further.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險模式」（Risk-Off）是指投資者情緒轉趨審慎，沽出科技股、增長股等較高風險的資產，資金轉投較穩陣的地方。在這類日子，高風險股份通常跌得較深，這正是今日納指跌幅大於標普500的原因。避險日暫停建立新倉，有助避免在股價進一步下跌前高位入市。

market_education.summary_en: Technology stocks led the market lower today: the NASDAQ fell 1.0%, more than double the S&P 500's 0.4% decline, which points to selling in growth names rather than a broad sell-off. When the tech-heavy index underperforms like this, investors are often taking profits in high-flying stocks or growing cautious about expensive valuations. No specific news headlines were provided in today's data, so no particular catalyst can be cited for the move.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日科技股領跌大市，納斯達克指數下挫1.0%，跌幅是標普500指數（-0.4%）的兩倍以上，顯示沽壓主要集中在增長股，而非全面拋售。科技比重較高的指數明顯跑輸，往往反映投資者在高位獲利回吐，或對估值偏高的板塊轉趨審慎。由於今日數據未附相關新聞標題，暫時無法指出觸發是次調整的具體消息。
